newsitem.title: USA: Vermont lawmakers to seek input on school funding.
newsitem.headline: Vermont lawmakers to seek input on school funding.

text.p: The Vermont House Ways and Means Committee wants input from citizens on school funding and the various proposals being put forward to replace the property tax method.
Committee members plan to go on tour after Tuesday's town meetings, which are held throughout the state, and give voters a chance to have their say on local issues from snowplows to school budgets.

The committee has been charged with drawing up a bill to put before the legislature when the property tax reform issue is debated during the next few weeks. The lawmakers plan public hearings in Brattleboro, White River Junction, Rutland, Burlington and Saint Johnsbury.

At local town meetings, one of the top issuses is school budgets and the broader question of how to replace a local property tax system of paying for schools, which the State Supreme Court has deemed unconstitutional.
